long_biography.plain_text:
Before Cecotec became a household-technology brand, the Orts brothers supplied imported products to third parties and designed promotional appliances for newspapers. As that channel weakened after the financial crisis, they chose to sell under their own name and focused the business on Spain's online market.

The breakthrough came in 2016, when Cecotec redesigned its Conga robot vacuum with mopping, stronger suction and improved brushes. Orts has kept product development central to his leadership: Spanish teams analyse customer needs and specify components, while suppliers handle manufacturing. That model has supported expansion from small kitchen appliances into white goods, televisions, electric mobility and other home categories.
